new_value: {"notes":"BLOCKED 2026-08-27 after completing generic Rust Observe prerequisite 7.11.2. Exact lower-layer prerequisite created as project-LICHEN-worker6-2hn1. The patched dependency /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore implements Context::begin_unprotect_response by decoding request_piv and immediately rejecting is_received_response_reuse(request_seq); PendingResponse::commit always calls mark_received_response(request_seq). Therefore after the initial protected response commits, every later Observe notification bound to the same request is rejected as Replay before its explicit fresh responder PIV can authorize it. That behavior is correct for ordinary one-shot responses but incompatible with RFC 8613 Observe. The dependency is outside this shared repository, so no external edits were made. 2hn1 specifies an explicit multi-response API that retains ordinary one-shot/no-PIV semantics while accepting only unique authenticated explicit responder PIVs and preserving atomic replay rejection/40-bit bounds. No current-leaf source edits; sibling ownership is clear (status worker only Zephyr coap_status, replay worker only Zephyr link persistence). Once 2hn1 lands, integrate send_secure_observe registration options and RequestCorrelation lifecycle with the completed no_std ObserveClient/ObserveServer, then cover exact CON retransmits, NON, cancellation/RST, wrong context/corruption, Block2, and exhaustion. Prior focused Python secure gates remain 103 passed with the known invalid half-range vector xfail."}
